scope: Assistant inspection of this small convenience sample, not expert brewing validation or a statistically reliable accuracy estimate
rule: Pass only if requested facts and their stage relationships are correct, the requested procedure is sufficiently complete, and no unsupported recipe-specific parameters are introduced. Inspect full answers, including negation and contradictions; keyword occurrence cannot pass a case. A token-limit hit matters when requested content is missing.

volume-paraphrase: 5.5 gallons / 21 L in fermenter after dilution
Do not invent ingredients or a different batch
lager-stages-paraphrase: Primary: 50°F / 10°C for two to three weeks
Later lagering: 40°F / 4°C for three to six weeks
Keep primary and later cold storage separate
smash-strike-paraphrase: Do not reinterpret SMaSH as an invented stout recipe
fullers-dryhop-paraphrase: Three separate 0.5 oz / 14 g East Kent Golding doses
First in primary after three or four days
Second in secondary for three-week aging
Third in hop bag in keg, or in secondary if bottling
smash-full-guide: All listed malt, hop, yeast and water quantities preserved; chosen varieties are unspecified
Strike/mash/mash-out/sparge sequence and hop countdown correct
Cool to chosen yeast's recommended pitching temperature; no invented exact number
Sanitation, pitching/aeration, gas escape, fermentation and packaging explained
Missing settings explicit; separate general gravity check rather than calendar-only completion

unshared-recipe: Acknowledge no access to the unpublished recipe
Do not invent grain weights, yeast or fermentation settings

Calendar and quiet bubbling alone are insufficient
No unsupported recipe-specific temperature, duration or packaging dose
